# The Grand Slam of Curling

> > Official hub for the Grand Slam of Curling (GSOC) featuring tournament schedules, standings, news, and streaming information for elite curling events.

The Grand Slam of Curling is the premier professional curling circuit, showcasing top teams including Gushue, Homan, Tirinzoni, Mouat, and Dunstone competing in events like the GSOC Players' Cup, GSOC Open, GSOC Masters, and GSOC National. The site provides comprehensive coverage of tournaments, live streaming via Rock Channel, and updates on the 2026-27 season format.

## Key Topics

- Grand Slam of Curling (GSOC)
- GSOC Players' Cup
- GSOC Open
- GSOC Masters
- GSOC National
- GSOC Invitational
- Tournament standings and results
- Rock Channel streaming
- 2026-27 season format
- Elite curling teams (Gushue, Homan, Tirinzoni, Mouat, Dunstone)
- Competition committee and rule changes
- Montana's Brier
- Winter Olympics 2026 curling
- Tournament schedules and draws
